Type: acceptance gate
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: F06
Accountable role (person unassigned): Integration engineer with curator
Pilot scope: required

Outcome: A retained end-to-end demonstration of sign-in, organization, sharing and offboarding across two labs.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Exercise real browser/HTTP/PostgreSQL with two labs, reader/contributor/steward roles, one external collaborator and a migrated preexisting dataset.
2. Demonstrate denied discovery, sharing/revocation, membership removal, principal disablement, concurrent role changes and stewardship handover while preserving historical releases and attribution.
3. Retain source-bound automated and human workflow/accessibility evidence with explicit not-run provider or screen-reader gates; completion of this tranche does not assert institutional readiness.

Review all child evidence against these integration criteria. Children closing does not automatically close this gate. Required human/institutional evidence must be observed, never inferred from automated tests.
Required child work:
- F06.1: bd-01M4W5P73PDDY9HX9J9F27RVRQ
- F06.2: bd-01M4W5P7C89WZQYKNBKHNCFG6S

Blocked by:
- F06.1: bd-01M4W5P73PDDY9HX9J9F27RVRQ
- F06.2: bd-01M4W5P7C89WZQYKNBKHNCFG6S

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; create blocking remediation work for discovered scope. Automated or simulated evidence cannot replace a required institutional or human result. No implementation is claimed by this plan.
